lines: A dull, senseless world repeats.
The clamor made me cover my ears.
Why are we hurting each other?
Can you hear my heartbeat?
Baby, I trust you, my friend
In the corner of my heart bowed by despair.
In the shadows of overlapping contradictions.
While my chest aches.
Can we dream of tomorrow?
Thinking of the rainbow I found after the passing rain.
Close your eyes, fly with me, any endless dream.
If I'm with you, it never fades.
Even an unvanishing rainbow can be drawn.
Even the moonlight we saw on the day we met.
Reflecting, again and again.
A world without sound that resonates delicately.
A crying‑faced clown laughs.
What should I wish upon the fallen star?
Everything is pointless, I dislike it all.
Holding my breath inside my head.
I restrained the fleeing me.
A way of living without mistakes.
Who taught that?
That dream seemed like endless glory.
Afraid of a certainty that fades.
Seeking something I can grasp.
I have even rejected peace.
It wasn't surrender.
To surpass the dream.
To the promised place.
I'll take you with me.
I'll take you to my world
I'll show you my sweet eternal dreams
Thinking of the rainbow I found after the passing rain.
Dream, fly with me, any dark sky.
If I'm with you, it shines.
Beyond the monochrome rainbow.
The unvanishing scenery, the world in your eyes.
Reflecting, again and again.
